explanation:
[EFFECT] Month shows a broadly seasonal, non-monotonic rise from a winter low to a late-summer/autumn high: January has the most negative contributions (~−0.65), values climb through spring, turn positive from around May, and peak around September–October (~+0.20). December sits at a mild positive level (~+0.10), slightly lower than the autumn peak.
[IMPORTANCE] This is a moderate-importance feature with a vertical range of roughly 0.8 log-units, sitting in the middle of the ranking.
[RECOMMENDATION] Plan your staffing and bike availability primarily around the hour of the day — the evening peak (around 5–6 pm) and the morning shoulder (around 8 am) drive the largest swings in demand — and use temperature as the key weather signal, targeting comfortable mild days (~20–25 °C) for maximum expected ridership and scaling back during cold or very hot spells.
